items.name: Berkeley November Weekday Favorites 2026

venue.name: SOCS 20
venue.details: This venue is NOT the normal Pauley Ballroom venue!

items.information:
## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend. 

## This competition is also a favorites competition. Please read the Favorites Competition Format tab before registering. You are only able to register for a limited number of the events available at this competition

## This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 6-9pm), otherwise you will not be allowed to compete.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
- Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
- Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.name: Cottbus Cubing 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4NjQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ab88a0502a3ba472356141b81e552f91ce257a19/image.png)

### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. November wollen wir an den Erfolg des Vorjahres anknüpfen und Euch alle wieder herzlichst nach Cottbus einladen. Dieses Jahr möchten wir uns sogar noch steigern und gehen mit mehr Teilnehmenden und mehr Comp-Tagen an den Start. Dieses Jahr wird Cottbus Cubing von GANCube unterstützt

Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln!

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

### English

Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days. This year, Cottbus Cubing is being supported by GANCube

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!

**Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.**

Vielen Dank!
Habt alle ein entspanntes Wochenende

venue.name: Per Brahegymnasiet
venue.details: Tävlingen hålls i matsalen, som är en separat byggnad (Brunnsgatan 3). Alltså inte ingång genom skolans huvudentré.

items.information:
Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2026! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)".

-----

Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2026!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)".
